# Names, categories, and blocks of Unicode characters that the JDK may not know.
# Generated from the Unicode Character Database 18.0.0 (DerivedName, DerivedGeneralCategory, DerivedAge, and Blocks).
# Lists only characters newer than Unicode 13.0 (the version in Java 17), plus the name pattern ranges and every block.
# Do not edit by hand. To regenerate:
#   1. Download these five files from https://www.unicode.org/Public/UCD/latest/ucd/ into one folder:
#      DerivedName.txt and DerivedGeneralCategory.txt (both in the extracted/
#      subfolder), DerivedAge.txt, Blocks.txt, and license.txt.
#   2. Run: gradlew :glyph-workbench:updateUnicodeNames -PucdDir=<that folder>
# Line formats:
#   '<HEX> <CATEGORY> <NAME>' is one character. The category is its two-letter
#   General_Category code, such as Lu or So.
#   '<HEX>..<HEX> <CATEGORY> <PREFIX>*' is a range of characters with one category.
#   A character's name is the prefix followed by its code point in hex.
#   'BLOCK <HEX>..<HEX> <NAME>' is a Unicode block.
#
# The Unicode data in this file is covered by this license:
